data.text:
Luke, I learned to fish here with my family, and I want our village to keep earning from this lake—not just have one good month. Taking 15 each gives us an extra $5,000 now, but leaves only 50 tons next month, supporting just 5 tons each sustainably unless we cut back further to rebuild. That’s a poor trade for a living we depend on.

I’ll choose 10 tons this month, and I’m asking everyone to agree to the same limit. When catches are revealed, let’s review them together and agree on next month’s shares based on what’s actually left. Private choices mean trust matters; they don’t make overfishing our best option. John, will you join me at 10?
